title: Registry: backup take (pg_dump the Harbor metadata DB)
description: Runs `nexus backup take registry`. pg_dumps the Harbor metadata DB (registry — projects, repositories, users, robots, replication rules) on the PG primary to a node-local gzip and reports the table count + size. Image blobs are EC-durable in MinIO s3://harbor; Redis is ephemeral cache — neither is adapter-snapshotted.
whatProves: RegistryAdapter.BackupTakeAsync pg_dumps the registry DB on the current PG primary to a node-local gzip and reports the table count + byte size — the adapter-ownable authoritative Harbor metadata.
